tr.en: Unfortunately, this misconception is very persistent.

tr.en: He attributes his success to hard work.

tr.en: I was trying to follow her, but she gave me the slip.

tr.en: You look tired, so you should go to bed early.

tr.en: Her kitchen is equipped with labor-saving devices.

tr.en: Chew your food well so it can be digested properly.

tr.en: It was determined that faulty wiring was the cause of the fire.

tr.en: Don't make fun of her. She just chugged three bottles of beer.

tr.en: Are there enough chairs to seat 12 people?

tr.en: I haven't decided yet whether I'll go to college or get a job.

tr.en: According to the terms of the contract, your payment was due on May 31st.

ускоряет.text: Правда ли, что имбирь ускоряет кровообращение и улучшает обмен веществ?

tr.en: Is it true that ginger increases circulation and improves your metabolism?

tr.en: His company was singled out as the most successful small business in the region.

усама.text: В Пакистане американскими войсками убит лидер «Аль-Каиды» Усама бен Ладен.

tr.en: Al-Qaeda leader Osama Bin Laden has been killed by US forces in Pakistan.

услуг.text: Пятипроцентный потребительский налог взимается с большинства товаров и услуг в Японии.

tr.en: A 5% consumption tax is levied on most goods and services in Japan.
